properties.title: SALAMANDER Mining — Workload Contract & API Lock

content: Locked boundary: separately scoped mining-workload integration of the SALAMANDER enterprise control plane. It does not redefine the enterprise product or grant a second mining authority. The owner's purpose is business funding, not a universal product identity. Status: documentation-level responsibility split; live mining acceptance, current bindings and runtime qualification open. Not a new deployed service or approved revenue claim. ## Owned obligations Translate authorised mining integration health into truthful SALAMANDER health/lifecycle evidence; stage or apply only registered, permitted modes/actions through the existing mining control authority; preserve quarantine, circuit breakers, evidence and rollback. ## Source-documented integration API Historical SALAMANDER integration consumes ProductionMiningIntegration and IntelligentPoolCoordinator.apply_salamander_mode. These are the named integration seam, not newly verified call signatures or network routes. The record references python scripts/check_salamander_autonomic.py as the acceptance entry point, executing inherited integration acceptance and a focused deterministic suite. Pin the actual component/version, mode enumeration, payload schema, action authorisation, result/error schema and replay policy before ABI freeze. No pool URL, wallet or credential is required to write this contract; none is stored here. ## Non-negotiable authority split - Canonical proof/hash/target, Stratum and pool submission/acceptance remain with their existing mining owners. - ExecutionRouter retains execution routing; RecoveryGovernor retains its bounded recovery authority. SALAMANDER does not duplicate them. - AL HARAS retains policy authority; Chronus retains device-execution truth; Kellogg retains tensor mathematics. - Theseus/Ovid storage binding must name its lineage/version; legacy projection and newer durable-custody roles cannot be mixed silently. - Observations, projections, candidate counts and structural metrics are not reward, hashrate, accepted shares or revenue. - Kairos lab rehearsal remains single-operator/in-process with no live pool, wallet, credential or submission authority; this adapter does not promote it to a live miner. ## Contract acceptance requirements 1. Run a replay/synthetic workload with mining services disconnected; verify truthful unknown/unavailable status, bounded modes, duplicate-action protection, quarantine and rollback. 2. Demonstrate rejected unauthorised actions and no silent device/f64/exactness fallback. 3. Qualify real device execution separately where required. 4. Only with explicit operational authorisation and secure configuration, run a controlled live integration and retain independently attributable pool acceptance evidence. Local candidate success is not acceptance. These are requirements, not completed checks. The historical record says focused pytest NOT\_RUN, inherited acceptance NOT\_RUN, CI NOT\_REPORTED, physical evidence required and authorised live pool NOT\_RUN. No updated pass is inferred from merge status. CI is currently deferred; local evidence may be developed without inventing CI outcomes. ## Customer / internal funding schedule Keep mining operational cost, permissions, risk and measured proceeds separate from enterprise customer savings/billing. No profitability or yield guarantee. No default authority to handle customer wallets, private keys or funds. Distribution/license rights, support and any external offer require explicit approval. ## Source traceability - #108 SALAMANDER_AUTONOMIC_CONTROL_PLANE - KAIROS_MINING_LAB_SERVICE - HYBA — Enterprise Product Lock Register
